
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/lizhaoyao/p/19107151" title="发布于 2025-09-23 14:30">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">ruoyi-vue列表显示关联</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>之前我们讲解了如何使用ruoyi去自动生成代码，自动做成菜单，增删改查的功能都有了，现在我们来做点改进，比如这里需要显示正确的姓名。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/704203/202509/704203-20250923140916825-1264261284.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;而且同时我们还想让这个自增长编号这一列不再显示，那么我们需要打开这段html的代码。</p>
<p>ruoyi-ui/src/views/system/salary/index.vue 打开这个文件</p>
<p>找到这里</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/704203/202509/704203-20250923141046604-2133126276.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>我们可以把这里的&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">el-table-column </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">label</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="自增长编号"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> align</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="center"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> prop</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="id"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span></span>&nbsp;</p>
<p>改为&nbsp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">el-table-column </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">label</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="自增长编号"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> align</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="center"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> prop</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="id"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> v-if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="false"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span></p>
<p>然后我们刷新页面，发现这里的自增长编号已经隐藏了。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/704203/202509/704203-20250923141236914-2069341054.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>然后就是如何显示员工编号了，我们看一下表结构就知道了</p>
<p>salary 表里面的 personId 关联的就是 sys_user 表里面的 user_id，那我们可以做一个关联查询看看。</p>
<p>找到这个文件&nbsp;ruoyi-admin/src/main/resources/mapper/system/SalaryMapper.xml， 然后找到这里的代码</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/704203/202509/704203-20250923141450764-196489315.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;这里改改，我们做成 left join 看看。</p>
<p>改为这样的查询SQL&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">select</span> id, u.<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">user_name</span>, personId, <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">month</span>, salary <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> salary <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">as</span> s <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">left</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">join</span> sys_user <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">as</span> u <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">on</span> s.personId <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span> u.<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">user_id</span></pre>
</div>
<p>然后我们将这个查询的字段和属性进行一个匹配</p>
<p>找到这里的代码，增加一行</p>
<p>&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">result </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">property</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="userName"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> column</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="user_name"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span></span>&nbsp;</p>
<p>如下：</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/704203/202509/704203-20250923142926152-1051895239.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;好了，然后我们需要将这个字段展示病返回，然后渲染出来。</p>
<p>找到&nbsp;ruoyi-admin/src/main/java/com/ruoyi/system/domain/Salary.java 文件里面增加一个成员属性然后做一个 get 方法</p>
<p>增加一段代码</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/**</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 用户姓名 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    @Excel(name </span>= "用户姓名"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> String userName;</pre>
</div>
<p>成这样：</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/704203/202509/704203-20250923141720797-1970506939.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;然后下面再增加get方法</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> String getUserName() 
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> userName;
    }</span></pre>
</div>
<p>成这样：</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/704203/202509/704203-20250923141849777-1380423291.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;好，之后再在最底下的查询返回里面增加这一列。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>            .append("userName", getUserName())</pre>
</div>
<p>成这样：</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/704203/202509/704203-20250923141930935-1599990707.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>然后我们需要在页面上面进行展示，所以我们打开&nbsp;ruoyi-ui/src/views/system/salary/index.vue 文件，找到这里：</p>
<p>&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">el-table-column </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">label</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="员工编号"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> align</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="center"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> prop</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="personId"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span></span>&nbsp;</p>
<p>改为</p>
<p>&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">el-table-column </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">label</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="员工姓名"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> align</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="center"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> prop</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="userName"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span></span>&nbsp;</p>
<p>然后我们可以将服务停止，重新编译，得到结果。</p>
<p>1.首先把服务ctrl+c停止掉，在项目目录下执行&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">mvn clean&nbsp;install&nbsp;-Dmaven.test.skip=true&nbsp;</span></p>
<p>2.然后再在 ruoyi-admin 下面的文件夹target里面执行&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">java -jar ruoyi-admin.jar</span>&nbsp;，不过可能提示你&nbsp;<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>Error: Unable to access jarfile ruoyi-admin.jar</strong></span>，这是因为你需要重新进一下这个目录，可以执行&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">cd ../ &amp;&amp; cd target &amp;&amp; java -jar ruoyi-admin.jar</span>&nbsp;</p>
<p>3.然后就在前端的 ruoyi-ui 里面执行&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">npm run dev&nbsp;</span></p>
<p>好了，所有服务重新启动，然后让你重新登录，登录后就可以看到这样的页面了。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/704203/202509/704203-20250923143003490-978490130.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;好了，这样就是一个关联查询病显示对应字段的一个完整的例子了。</p>
</div>
